tellings.difference: Told firsthand. Adds that Graves first saw the video in a classified space and doesn't name which video it was.
tellings.link_reason: Graves himself says the released video was recorded by his good friend, which is the claim Jesse Michels relays secondhand in the story.

as_told.title: Graves recognizes the released video from the classified space, recorded by his friend

plain: One of the Navy videos of unidentified objects that the New York Times made public in 2017, a clip filmed off Jacksonville, Florida, in 2015 and known as Go Fast, was recorded by a close friend of the Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves, according to Graves. He tells Michels he first saw the video in a classified space and says of his "very good buddy" who recorded it, "I'm not going to say his name," though in his own words he never names which video he means. Michels later repeats it, saying Graves, who has also testified before Congress under oath, "kind of admitted it was a buddy of his"; if so, the video would come with a known, if unnamed, crew member behind it.
